name: Kunsthalle Münster
funding: Municipal institution of the City of Münster's Kulturamt. Residence NRW+ fellowships are paid equally by the NRW culture ministry and Kunststiftung NRW, with Pro Helvetia. A Freundeskreis helps.

name: Haus für Medienkunst Oldenburg
funding: Exhibition house of the City of Oldenburg. Stiftung Niedersachsen pays three media-art grants of €12,500 a year. The building came from donations by Edith Ruß and Elisabeth Brand.

name: Kunsthalle Recklinghausen
funding: Museen der Stadt Recklinghausen, NRW culture ministry, Kunststiftung NRW, Sparkasse Vest, Ruhrfestspiele (city and DGB union federation), Förderverein für Bildende Kunst; WDR 3 media partner.

name: Akademie Schloss Solitude
funding: A public-law foundation run and financed by the state of Baden-Württemberg; programme partners include KfW Stiftung and Robert Bosch GmbH.

name: Künstlerhaus Stuttgart
funding: Stuttgart council funds it with an institutional grant of 650.000 EUR a year.

name: Württembergischer Kunstverein Stuttgart
funding: State of Baden-Württemberg Ministry of Science, Research and the Arts, City of Stuttgart; non-profit association.

name: Vitra Design Museum
funding: 2025-26: private foundation subsidised by Vitra AG; show sponsors include Maharam, Camper and IKEA Stiftung, plus the Design Circle friends.

name: Chale Wote Street Art Festival
funding: Free street festival (15th edition Aug 2025) by ACCRA [dot] ALT; 2023 supported by Ghana's tourism ministry, Ghana Tourism Authority, Citi FM, Institut Français.

name: Gallery 1957
funding: Commercial gallery founded in 2016 by British Lebanese construction owner Marwan Zakhem. Its Yaa Asantewaa Art Prize pays GHC 50,000 to the winner.

name: Nubuke Foundation
funding: Private foundation from 2006. Funded through the EU and OACPS ACP-EU Culture programme (AWA consortium with Institut français) and the British Council Digital Collaboration Fund.

name: blaxTARLINES KUMASI
funding: Art network and incubator tied to the KNUST painting and sculpture department in Kumasi.
